definition: Commercial, contractual and management arrangements for procuring, controlling and exiting cloud services. Includes cloud framework agreements, provider panels, service catalogues, IaaS, PaaS and SaaS procurement, service levels, shared-responsibility requirements, pricing and cost controls, FinOps, consumption monitoring, provider accreditation, portability, reversibility, exit planning, data return and deletion. Excludes general IT procurement with no cloud service, procurement of datacenter construction or equipment, cloud strategy without contracting or management arrangements, and cybersecurity accreditation that is not related to cloud providers or services.
